title: Python Fundamentals for a TypeScript/Node.js Developer
description: Build an accurate Python runtime mental model and learn the language features that matter in backend code.
learningOutcomes: Explain Python execution, imports, names, references, and mutability
Write expressive collection and function code without common Python traps
Use exceptions, iterators, generators, decorators, context managers, and dunder methods appropriately
Build an in-memory domain and repository layer for the course project

lessons.title: Runtime, Modules, Names, and References
lessons.description: How Python executes code and why names are labels rather than typed storage slots.
learningObjectives: Run code as a script and module
Explain name binding and object identity

lessons.title: Collections and Comprehensions
lessons.description: Choose and transform lists, tuples, sets, and dictionaries with backend-oriented examples.

lessons.title: Functions, Arguments, and Scope
lessons.description: Master Python call semantics, defaults, keyword arguments, variadics, closures, and exceptions.

lessons.title: Iterators, Generators, and Decorators
lessons.description: Understand Python protocols that power streaming, composition, and framework behavior.

lessons.title: Context Managers, Dunder Methods, and the Standard Library
lessons.description: Encode resource lifecycles, object behavior, and robust backend utilities.
learningObjectives: Apply pathlib, enum, datetime, and collections patterns

assignment.title: Assignment: In-Memory Task Repository
assignment.description: Create domain objects and a reliable in-memory repository for the cumulative Task API.
learningObjectives: Model backend state with Python objects
Connect this increment to the capstone
